title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-01-25

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a solid set featuring excellent jams and a standout Alligator > Feedback run.
ai_review.review: The show delivers several superb improvisational passages, though the new material at the start feels a bit rough. The highlight is the terrific Alligator into Feedback sequence that really lifts the energy. Recording quality appears adequate for a soundboard source, making the performance enjoyable despite the early unevenness.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review emphasizes strong jams and a notable Alligator > Feedback segment, indicating a good musical performance with acceptable recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on sound clarity; identifier suggests a soundboard source and overall rating implies listenable quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Rough new‑tune introductions give way to tighter, high‑energy jams later in the set.
